_meta.method: Executed with pi-dash/.venv (pydantic-ai/pydantic-core/fastmcp/genai-prices versions below), Django local settings for real tool imports; no DB rows touched. Schemas via real Agent tool defs; MCP via FastMCP replica wrappers AST-asserted against github_mcp.py; validation/coercion via stub-driven Agent.run battery.

github_get_file.description: Read a UTF-8 repository file from the verified GitHub binding.

github_get_linked_pull_request.description: Read summary, diff, files, checks, reviews, or comments for the linked GitHub PR.

pidash_add_current_issue_comment.description: Add one Markdown comment to the current issue.

pidash_create_project_issue.description: Create one backlog/default-state issue in the scheduler's project.

pidash_get_current_issue.description: Read the issue bound to this run.

pidash_get_project_issue.description: Get one issue by UUID, limited to this run's project.

pidash_list_current_issue_comments.description: List the newest 50 comments on the issue bound to this run.

pidash_list_issue_relations.description:
List an issue's relations grouped by type from its side (blocked_by, blocking,
relates_to, ...), each with identifier, name and state. Defaults to the current issue.

pidash_list_linked_code_reviews.description: List code reviews linked to the current issue.

pidash_list_project_states.description: List valid workflow states for the bound project.

pidash_relate_issues.description:
Record `issue <relation_type> each related issue` (identifiers like PROJ-12 or UUIDs).
relation_type is read from `issue`'s side: blocked_by, blocking, relates_to, duplicate,
start_before, start_after, finish_before, finish_after, implemented_by, implements.
Idempotent: existing pairs come back under `unchanged`, pairs with a different relation
under `conflicts` (left as is). `issue` must be in this run's project.

pidash_search_project_issues.description: Search issue titles and descriptions in the bound project (max 50).

pidash_transition_current_issue.description: Move the current issue to a state in the same project.

pidash_unrelate_issues.description:
Remove the `relation_type` relation between `issue` and each related issue. Pairs
without it come back under `not_related`. `issue` must be in this run's project.

pidash_update_current_issue_workpad.description: Replace the current issue's durable Markdown workpad.

github_get_file.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 file from the run's verified project repository.

github_get_linked_pull_request.description: Read one bounded aspect of the GitHub PR already linked to the run's issue.

output_schema.name: final_result
output_schema.description: The final response which ends this conversation
